messages:
sophie: Hotfix heads-up — serializer crash seen in prod when a request exceeds ~200 tokens. Patch is ready (2.3.8) and small: tokenizer config + image bump. Need expedited approval for the midnight change window (~30m). Plan: canary 5% -> 100% in 15m if metrics look good. Rollback to 2.3.7 if error-rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 500ms. No DB migration.

deploy-bot: Deploy request received from @sophie
- image: `redwood/serving:2.3.8-hotfix`
- targets: eu-west1,dedicated-pool-3
- strategy: staged canary (5% -> 100%)
- smoke job: `smoke/serializer-warmup` (512-token run)

liam: quick q — any client changes required? or backward-incompatible inference outputs?

sophie: no client changes. output identical, only fixes crash. smoke job covers behavior.

maya: I can give expedited :thumbsup: if ops oncall is aware and rollback gate is automated. Can you add the rollback probe to the job?

sophie: added probe: error_rate > 0.5% over 2m OR spikes in p95 > 500ms for 2m triggers automatic rollback. Also added an alert runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serializer-hotfix

dan: I can act as release owner and execute the pin/rollback if needed. @rebecca are you OK to be oncall for the window?

ops-bot: Paging oncall: @rebecca (medium) — acknowledge within 5m to avoid auto-escalation.

rebecca: ack — I'm watching. will verify canary telemetry and be ready to roll back.

liam: :+1: from me. please add a short release note snippet for the changelog.

sophie: release note: "Fix serializer crash on long inputs causing 5xx. Patch 2.3.8: tokenizer config tuned." will attach to release PR now.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 1767543300 -> starting canary (5%). CLI preview:

```
/deploy --image redwood/serving:2.3.8-hotfix \
  --targets eu-west1,dedicated-pool-3 \
  --strategy canary --canary-percent 5 --canary-duration 15m \
  --smoke smoke/serializer-warmup --rollback-probe "err_rate>0.5%||p95>500"
```

sophie: starting smoke now, will post results in ~2m.

(2m later)
sophie: smoke looked clean — no errors, p95 stable. kicking canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 5% at 1767543330. Observability hooks active.

rebecca: watching traces and SLOs. no regressions so far.

maya: approving expedited ramp to 100% if no issues in 10m.

sophie: ramping to 100% in 5m if green. will post final.

(10m later)
sophie: ramp complete, 100% on 2.3.8. monitoring for 30m post-deploy. thanks everyone for quick approvals :rocket:

liam: thanks — please follow up with post-deploy note and tag support in case any related tickets surface.

sophie: will add post-deploy note + link to release PR."
